description: getDeploymentFileContents' 200 response has NO content schema in the OpenAPI document, so the generated GetDeploymentFileContentsResponse is an empty struct and the decoded value drops the payload. The live API returns a JSON body { data: "<base64>" } with the file contents encoded as base64 (live-verified against a prebuilt deployment's .vc-config.json — see alchemy test/Vercel/Chains/QueueEvolution.test.ts, which reads the consumer function's experimentalTriggers out-of-band). Add the response schema so `data` survives decoding.

value.description: The file contents, base64-encoded inside a JSON envelope
